recipes.name: Besan chilla chickpea flour pancakes
ingredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) water, plus a little more if needed
steps: Finely chop the onion, tomato, cilantro and chili. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the besan, water, salt, turmeric and cumin into a smooth batter like thin pancake batter.
Stir in the vegetables and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and brush it with oil.
Pour in 1/3 cup of batter and spread it into a thin circle with the back of the ladle.
Drizzle a few drops of oil around the edge and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the bottom is golden.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve hot with green chutney, ketchup or yogurt.

recipes.name: Aloo paratha potato stuffed flatbread
ingredients: 2 cups (250 g) whole wheat flour (atta), plus more for rolling
1/2 teaspoon salt, plus 3/4 teaspoon for the filling
1/2 teaspoon amchur (dry mango powder) or 1 teaspoon lemon juice
steps: Mix the flour and salt, then add water little by little and knead for 5 minutes into a soft dough.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Boil the whole potatoes for 20 to 25 minutes, until a knife slides in. Ask an adult to help.
Peel the potatoes and mash them until smooth with no lumps.
Mix in the filling salt, spices, chili and cilantro.
Split the dough and filling into 4 balls each.
Roll a dough ball into a 4 inch circle, put a filling ball in the middle, and pinch the edges closed.
Flatten it, dust with flour and gently roll into a 7 inch circle.
Cook in a hot dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute, until spots appear, then flip.
Brush with ghee and cook for 1 to 2 minutes per side, pressing down, until golden. Serve with yogurt.

recipes.name: Ful medames
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) fava beans, with their liquid
3 tablespoons olive oil, plus more to serve
Chopped parsley, hard boiled eggs and warm pita to serve
steps: Put the beans and their liquid in a pot over medium heat.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
Mash about half of the beans with a potato masher.
Stir in the olive oil, garlic, cumin, salt and lemon juice.
Spoon into bowls and top with tomato, parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve with eggs and warm pita for scooping.

recipes.name: Ackee and saltfish
ingredients: 1/4 scotch bonnet pepper, seeded and chopped (optional, very hot)
steps: Soak the salt cod in cold water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Boil it in fresh water for 15 minutes to take out more salt. Drain and flake into small pieces.
Slice and chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help, and wear gloves for the scotch bonnet.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, peppers, garlic and scotch bonnet for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the tomato, thyme and salt cod and cook for 3 minutes.
Gently fold in the ackee. It breaks easily.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until hot, and season with black pepper. Serve with fried dumplings or boiled green bananas.

recipes.name: Jamaican fried dumplings
ingredients: 2 tablespoons (30 g) cold butter, in pieces
Vegetable oil for frying, about 1 inch deep
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Rub in the butter with your fingers until it looks like crumbs.
Add water little by little and knead into a soft, smooth dough.
Shape into 10 balls and flatten each slightly.
Have an adult heat 1 inch of oil in a heavy pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry a few dumplings at a time for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with ackee and saltfish or butter.

recipes.name: Jamaican cornmeal porridge
ingredients: 1 cinnamon stick or 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 cup (60 ml) sweetened condensed milk, or sugar to taste
steps: Stir the cornmeal into 1 cup of the water in a bowl until smooth.
Bring the rest of the water, coconut milk, salt and cinnamon to a boil in a pot.
Slowly pour in the cornmeal mix, whisking all the time so no lumps form.
Turn the heat to low and cook for 15 minutes, stirring often, until thick and smooth.
Stir in the nutmeg, vanilla and condensed milk.
Take out the cinnamon stick and serve hot.

recipes.name: Cheese arepas
ingredients: 2 cups (240 g) pre-cooked white cornmeal (masarepa, like P.A.N.)
Butter and extra cheese to serve
steps: Mix the masarepa and salt in a bowl.
Pour in the warm water and mix with your hands until there are no lumps.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then knead in the mozzarella. It should feel like soft play dough.
Shape into 6 balls and flatten each into a disk about 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the arepas for 6 to 8 minutes per side, until a golden crust forms.
Split them open with a knife while warm and fill with butter and cheese. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Gallo pinto
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, with 1/4 cup of their liquid
3 cups (500 g) cold cooked white rice
2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce or Salsa Lizano
Fried eggs and sour cream to serve
steps: Chop the onion, pepper, garlic and cilantro. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans and their liquid and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, Worcestershire sauce and salt and stir for 4 to 5 minutes, until hot and the rice turns light brown.
Stir in the cilantro and serve with fried eggs.

recipes.name: Korean street toast
steps: Shred the cabbage, grate the carrot and slice the green onion. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the eggs, vegetables and salt in a bowl.
Melt half the butter in a pan over medium heat and toast the bread for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Set it aside.
Melt the rest of the butter and spoon the egg mix into 2 square patties the size of the bread.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until set.
Put the ham in the pan for 30 seconds per side to warm it.
On a slice of toast, stack an egg patty, ham and cheese.
Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar, squeeze on ketchup, and top with a second slice.

recipes.name: Full English breakfast
ingredients: 4 slices back bacon or regular bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 200°F (93°C) to keep things warm. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the sausages in a big pan with the oil over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until browned and 160°F (71°C) inside. Keep them warm in the oven.
Cook the bacon in the same pan for 3 to 4 minutes per side. Keep it warm.
Cook the tomatoes cut side down and the mushrooms for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft.
Warm the beans in a small pot over low heat for 5 minutes.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes and toast and butter the bread.
Put everything on 2 warm plates and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Beans on toast
steps: Warm the beans in a small pot over medium-low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until bubbling.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Spoon the beans over the toast.
Sprinkle with cheese and pepper and eat right away.

recipes.name: Strapatsada Greek tomato eggs
ingredients: 3 ripe tomatoes, grated on a box grater, skins thrown away
steps: Cut the tomatoes in half and grate the cut side on the big holes of a box grater. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the grated tomato, salt and oregano and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until most of the liquid is gone.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until softly set.
Take off the heat and stir in the feta.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Slow cooker hash brown breakfast casserole
ingredients: 1 bag (30 oz / 850 g) frozen shredded hash browns
steps: Chop the onion and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the sausage in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Grease the slow cooker well.
Layer half the hash browns, half the sausage, half the vegetables and half the cheese. Repeat.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour it over the top.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, until the eggs are set in the middle.
Scoop out and serve.

recipes.name: Molletes
ingredients: 2 bolillo rolls or 1 small French baguette
1 1/2 cups (150 g) shredded Monterey Jack or Oaxaca cheese
Pico de gallo or salsa to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the rolls in half lengthwise and spread the cut sides with butter.
Toast them on a baking sheet for 5 minutes.
Spread each half with beans and cover with cheese.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese melts and bubbles.
Top with pico de gallo and serve warm.

recipes.name: Huevos a la mexicana
ingredients: 1 jalapeno or serrano chili, seeded and finely chopped
Warm corn tortillas and refried beans to serve
steps: Chop the onion, tomato and chili. Ask an adult to help, and wash your hands after the chili.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and chili for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the salt, pour them in, and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until just set.
Serve with warm tortillas and beans.

recipes.name: Banh mi op la Vietnamese pan eggs
ingredients: 2 slices ham or Vietnamese pork roll (optional)
2 teaspoons Maggi seasoning or soy sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat.
Lay the ham in the pan for 30 seconds per side.
Crack the eggs on top.
Cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are runny.
Sprinkle with pepper and drizzle with Maggi.
Serve in the pan with chunks of baguette for dipping, plus cucumber and cilantro.

recipes.name: Sweet potato hash with eggs
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
steps: Cut the sweet potatoes, onion and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Add the sweet potatoes, cover, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the onion, pepper and seasonings and cook uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are soft and browned.
Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 minutes, until the whites are set.
Serve with avocado.

recipes.name: English muffin breakfast pizzas
ingredients: 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella or cheddar
1/2 cup (120 ml) pizza sauce or salsa (optional)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Lay the muffin halves on a baking sheet and toast them for 5 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and salt and scramble in the butter over medium-low heat for 2 minutes, until soft.
Spread a little sauce on each muffin half.
Top with scrambled egg, bacon and cheese.
Bake for 6 to 8 minutes, until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Dodo and egg sauce
ingredients: 1/4 scotch bonnet pepper, finely chopped (optional, very hot)
steps: Peel the plantains and cut them into 1/2 inch slices on an angle. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a pan over medium heat. An adult should do the frying.
Fry the plantains for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt.
In another pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil and cook the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, peppers, salt and curry powder and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and thick.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until set.
Serve the egg sauce with the fried plantains.

recipes.name: Chorizo con huevo
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) raw Mexican chorizo, casings removed
Crumbled queso fresco and salsa to serve
steps: Cook the chorizo in a pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked through and a little crispy.
Spoon off extra grease into a heatproof cup, leaving about 1 tablespoon.
Whisk the eggs with the salt and pour them in.
Stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
Spoon into warm tortillas and top with queso fresco and salsa.

recipes.name: Pan con tomate
steps: Toast or grill the bread until crisp and golden.
Cut the tomatoes in half and grate the cut side on a box grater into a bowl. Throw away the skins. Ask an adult to help.
Rub the cut garlic lightly over the warm toast.
Spoon the grated tomato over the toast.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.name: Taiwanese egg crepe dan bing
ingredients: Soy paste or sweet chili sauce to serve
steps: Slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, cornstarch, salt and water into a thin, smooth batter. Stir in half the green onion.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and brush it with oil.
Pour in 1/3 of the batter and swirl to cover the pan. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until set.
Beat 1 egg with a little green onion and pour it over the crepe.
Cook for 1 minute, until the egg starts to set, then flip and cook for 1 minute more.
Roll it up, cut into pieces and repeat. Serve with soy paste or chili sauce.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon bagel
aliases: bagel with cream cheese and lox
steps: Thinly slice the onion, tomato and cucumber. Ask an adult to help.
Toast the bagels if you like.
Spread cream cheese on each half.
Lay the smoked salmon on top.
Add onion, capers, tomato, cucumber and dill.

recipes.name: Classic French omelette
steps: Beat the eggs and salt with a fork until no streaks of white remain.
Melt the butter in an 8 inch nonstick pan over medium-low heat until it foams.
Pour in the eggs and stir quickly with a rubber spatula while shaking the pan for 30 to 60 seconds, until they look like soft curds.
Stop stirring and smooth the eggs into an even layer. Cook for 20 seconds so the bottom sets but stays pale.
Tilt the pan and roll the omelette into thirds toward the edge.
Tip it seam side down onto a plate and sprinkle with chives. The inside should be soft and creamy.

recipes.name: Brazilian tapioca crepe
ingredients: 1 cup (120 g) hydrated tapioca flour (goma de tapioca), or see the first step
steps: If you only have dry tapioca starch, mix 1 cup with 1/4 cup water and rub with your fingers until it looks like damp sand, then push it through a sieve.
Mix in the salt.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Don't add oil.
Sieve half the tapioca into the pan and spread it into an even layer.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until it sticks together into one flat crepe.
Flip, then add cheese and ham to one half.
Fold in half and cook for 1 minute more, until the cheese melts. Spread with butter if you like.

recipes.name: Syrniki cheese pancakes
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) farmer cheese (tvorog) or very well drained cottage cheese
1/2 cup (65 g) all-purpose flour, plus more for shaping
Sour cream and jam to serve
steps: Mash the cheese with a fork until smooth.
Mix in the egg, sugar, vanilla and salt, then the flour, into a soft dough.
Scoop 2 tablespoons of dough, roll it in flour, and pat it into a thick patty. Make about 12.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat.
Cook the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and puffed.
Serve warm with sour cream and jam.

recipes.name: Hong Kong ham macaroni soup
steps: Cut the ham into strips. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the macaroni in water for 7 to 8 minutes, until tender. Drain.
Bring the broth to a simmer in a pot and add the ham and peas for 2 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the butter for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Put the macaroni in 2 bowls and pour the hot broth, ham and peas over it.
Top each with a fried egg, white pepper and a few drops of sesame oil.

recipes.name: Gyeran bap Korean egg rice
steps: Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat.
Fry the egg for 2 to 3 minutes, until the white is crispy at the edges and the yolk is runny.
Put the hot rice in a bowl and slide the egg on top.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Top with crumbled seaweed and green onion, then mix it all together and eat.

recipes.name: Tapsilog beef tapa with garlic rice and egg
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) thinly sliced beef sirloin
steps: Mince the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the soy sauce, juice, brown sugar, half the garlic and pepper. Add the beef and marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the beef in batches for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until browned. Keep warm.
Wipe the pan, add 1 tablespoon oil and cook the rest of the garlic over medium-low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until light golden.
Add the rice and salt and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes, until hot.
Fry the eggs in the last of the oil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve each plate with garlic rice, beef tapa and a fried egg.

recipes.name: Mangu Dominican mashed plantains
ingredients: Fried eggs, fried salami and fried cheese to serve (optional)
steps: Cut the ends off the plantains, slit the skin, and peel. Ask an adult to help.
Cut the plantains into chunks and boil in salted water for 20 to 25 minutes, until very soft.
Meanwhile, cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, add the vinegar and a pinch of salt and cook for 1 minute more.
Drain the plantains and mash them with the butter, adding the cold water a little at a time until smooth and creamy.
Spoon the onions over the mangu and serve with eggs, salami and cheese.

recipes.name: Chechebsa Ethiopian spiced flatbread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (190 g) all-purpose or whole wheat flour
4 tablespoons (60 g) butter or niter kibbeh (Ethiopian spiced butter)
Honey and plain yogurt to serve
steps: Mix the flour, salt and water into a thick, smooth batter like soft dough.
Heat a big nonstick pan over medium heat and spread the dough into one big thin round with wet fingers or a spatula.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until dry and spotted brown.
Tear the flatbread into small bite-size pieces.
Melt the butter in the pan over medium-low heat and stir in the berbere for 30 seconds.
Add the bread pieces and toss for 2 to 3 minutes, until coated and hot.
Serve drizzled with honey, with yogurt on the side.

recipes.name: Baghrir Moroccan semolina pancakes
steps: Blend the semolina, flour, yeast, baking powder, sugar, salt and warm water for 1 minute, until very smooth and thin.
Pour into a bowl, cover, and let rest for 30 minutes, until bubbly.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat. Don't grease it.
Pour in 1/4 cup of batter. Holes will appear on top.
Cook on one side only for 2 to 3 minutes, until the top has no wet spots left.
Lay each pancake on a clean towel in one layer to cool. Don't stack them hot.
Melt the butter and honey together and spoon it over the pancakes to serve.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Heat the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute, until wilted.
Spread the spinach out and pour the eggs over it.
Cook for 2 minutes, lifting the edges so runny egg flows under, until nearly set.
Sprinkle feta over half, fold the omelette over and cook for 30 seconds more.

recipes.name: Eggs Florentine
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the spinach for 2 minutes, until wilted. Season with salt and nutmeg.
Toast the English muffins.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water with the vinegar for 3 to 4 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Put spinach on each muffin half, then a poached egg.
Sprinkle with parmesan and pepper and serve.
